rationale: Avoid PyInstaller onefile as the first milestone because it has a higher antivirus false-positive and cold-start risk.
Keep a non-PyInstaller runtime path available until scanner results and build reproducibility are measured.

Electron supports resources/python/python.exe plus resources/naia-backend/NAIA_web_headless.py. The default release path now bundles a base-only Python runtime and creates the managed dependency environment on first launch.

python-runtime-folder.packaging_shape: Electron resources/python base runtime plus resources/naia-backend source resources; user-data/runtime-env is created on first launch
pros: Avoids PyInstaller bootloader false-positive surface for the first milestone
Keeps backend files inspectable and patchable
Works with the current staged backend smoke gate
cons: Larger file count than a single executable
Requires shipping a base Python runtime and installing Python packages into user-data/runtime-env
First launch depends on pip/network unless a wheelhouse is bundled

pyinstaller-onefile.reason: Higher false-positive and extraction/cold-start risk; only reconsider after onedir and Python-runtime-folder evidence.

hard_rules: The first serious packaging candidate must not be PyInstaller onefile.
UPX must not be used for backend packaging.
A non-PyInstaller backend runtime path must remain available.
Any accepted backend binary strategy must have a scanner result record.
Electron must be able to launch either a Python runtime folder or a future backend sidecar executable.

scanner_policy.minimum_gate: Microsoft Defender local scan plus vendor/aggregator scan notes before public distribution

code_signing_strategy.preferred_windows_signing: Microsoft Trusted Signing / Azure Artifact Signing or OV certificate; do not buy EV only for instant SmartScreen reputation
signing_scope: future frozen backend sidecar executable when introduced
code_signing_strategy.notes: SmartScreen reputation is file-hash and publisher reputation based; signing is required for trust but does not guarantee a no-warning first download.
